data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Japan Reports Progress on $550 Billion US Investment Pact
data.description: Japanese Trade Minister Ryosei Akazawa said progress was being made on a $550 billion investment initiative tied to a trade deal with the US last year, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Trader Loses About $907,000 After Two FOMO Trades in One Day
data.description:
A trader suffered combined losses of about $907,000 after making two consecutive FOMO trades in one day on September 5. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the trader first spent $916,500 to buy 7.28 million MEME at $0.126 each, then sold the position for only $353,000, resulting in a loss of $563,000 and a 61.45% decline.

The trader later invested $356,000 to buy 8.93 million SLINK at $0.04 each, but eventually sold for about $12,000, losing $344,000 in the process. The second trade represented a 96.62% drop.

BlockBeats reminded users that most meme coins have no practical use cases and are highly volatile, urging investors to protect their assets and avoid FOMO.

data.title: Hong Kong’s Lee Pledges Wider Offshore Yuan Use in Five-Year Plan
data.description:
Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan will focus on expanding offshore yuan usage and cross-border investment with the mainland, according to Bloomberg.

Lee said the plan will also cover other areas, but gave no further details.

data.title: Arbitrum Says Robinhood Chain Batch Releases Delayed by Ethereum L1 Blob Market Behavior
data.description:
Arbitrum said Robinhood Chain experienced delayed batch releases because of Ethereum L1 blob market behavior. According to Foresight News, direct user trading was not affected, but some infrastructure providers relying on Robinhood Chain data streams saw brief performance impacts due to too many subscribers.

Arbitrum said Robinhood Chain did not go offline and has now returned to normal operation.

data.title: Arbitrum Says Robinhood Chain Batch Submissions Were Delayed by L1 Blob Activity
data.description:
Arbitrum said on X that Robinhood Chain previously experienced batch submission delays because of L1 market blob activity, but direct user trading was not affected. According to Odaily, some infrastructure providers that rely on Robinhood Chain data streams were briefly affected by performance issues due to a large number of subscribers to their data sources.

Market reports had previously said Robinhood Chain appeared to experience a brief outage last night.

data.title: Anker Innovation Posts 29.05% Revenue Growth in First Half as Overseas Sales Reach 94.73%
data.description:
Anker Innovation reported first-half revenue of 16.605 billion yuan, up 29.05% year on year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 45.86% to 1.702 billion yuan and non-GAAP net profit increasing 49.65% to 1.439 billion yuan, according to Jiemian News. Overseas sales accounted for 94.73% of revenue.

The company said charging and storage revenue rose 31.02% to 8.93 billion yuan and remained its largest business, while smart innovation revenue climbed 28.77% to 4.186 billion yuan and smart audio revenue increased 24.53% to 3.485 billion yuan. Gross margin improved to 49.82% from a year earlier, and second-quarter gross margin reached 55.1%.

By region, overseas revenue totaled 15.729 billion yuan, with North America up 32.70% and Europe up 29.34%. Channel mix continued to shift, but Amazon still generated 7.699 billion yuan, or 46.37% of revenue, down from 49.97% a year earlier. Offline sales rose 25.37% to 5.255 billion yuan, while direct-to-consumer website revenue increased 39.19% to 1.837 billion yuan.

The article also said Anker had moved about two-thirds of its U.S.-export products to overseas production by September 2025, based on an institutional update disclosed in December 2025. It added that inventory rose to 6.734 billion yuan, up 34.75% from the start of the year, inventory write-downs reached 444 million yuan, and net foreign-exchange losses were 94 million yuan. Effective tax rate rose to 15.92% in the first half, up 8 percentage points year on year.

data.title: Hyperliquid Whale Positions Reach $7.65 Billion, ETH Short Address Shows $18.67 Million Unrealized Loss
data.description:
Coinglass data shows whale positions on Hyperliquid total $7.65 billion, with $3.66 billion in long positions and $3.996 billion in short positions. According to ChainCatcher, longs account for 47.78% of positions, while shorts account for 52.22%.

Long positions are showing $396 million in profit and loss, while short positions are showing a loss of $448 million. A whale address, 0x5b5d..60, is currently holding a 5x cross-margin ETH short opened at $2,220.62, with an unrealized loss of $18.67 million.

data.title: Linera Community Sale Raises About $150,000, Far Below $3.2 Million Target
data.description: Layer1 blockchain Linera has raised about $150,000 since launching its community round public sale on September 1, with 172 addresses participating and a 95.2% shortfall versus its $3.2 million target. According to ChainCatcher, the round values the token at $160 million and will run for seven days. Linera previously raised a total of $12 million in 2022 and 2023 from investors including a16z, GSR, Tribe Capital, Flow Traders, and Laser Digital.

data.title: Hong Kong to Release First Five-Year Plan, John Lee Says It Will Set Macro Strategy and Development Direction
data.description: According to Jin10, Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu will announce the first five-year plan for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, covering 2026 to 2030, on September 16 and then deliver a new Policy Address. He said the plan will set macro strategy, define development direction, and align with China's 15th Five-Year Plan, while the Policy Address will focus on specific measures. Lee said measures implemented over the past few years under the Policy Address have continued to advance finance, innovation and technology, and education, ensuring the effective operation of the gold central clearing system, building a commodity trading ecosystem, attracting leading global companies to the Hetao Hong Kong Park, and developing the Northern Metropolis University Town.

data.title: STOCKS | Pentagon Secures Right to Buy 20% of Venezuela Oil Output at Cost
data.description:
The Pentagon has secured priority rights to buy crude from 17 Venezuelan oil fields and, under a new agreement, can purchase 20% of output at cost rather than market price. According to Sina Finance, the report said the Pentagon has a separate priority right to buy oil extracted by NABEP, with the remaining output to be purchased at market prices.

The report also said the Pentagon obtained a 35% stake in the joint venture. According to Sina Finance, the deal uses special rights to buy equity at a symbolic price to protect the U.S. stake from dilution as the project attracts billions of dollars in outside investment, and to allow Washington to receive dividends from the start.

The United States and Venezuela previously announced a historic agreement involving investment in Venezuela and higher oil output. Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodriguez, said the alliance would help sharply increase oil production with private-sector participation. The agreement covers development of 17 strategic oil fields with proven reserves of 65 billion barrels, investment of more than $100 billion, and more than $200 billion in tax revenue for Venezuela.

data.title: AI TRENDS | OpenAI Codex Product Lead Says Astra Launches Early, Resets Preloads for Plus, Pro, and Business Users
data.description: According to Jin10, OpenAI Codex product lead said Astra launched early today and that preload resets will be applied to all Plus, Pro, and Business users. The reset will take effect at the end of today, and customers who sign up for an account or upgrade their plan before 8 p.m. Pacific time will also receive the benefit.

data.title: Ethereum Mainnet Sees $46.47 Million Net Inflow as L2s Record Outflows
data.description:
According to Defillama data, on-chain capital over the past day shifted toward Ethereum mainnet and a few established Layer 1 networks, with Ethereum posting $46.47 million in net inflows, about 4.5 times Solana's total. According to ChainCatcher, Robinhood Chain, Arbitrum, and Hyperliquid were among the biggest net outflow sources, with more than $100 million leaving those networks combined.

Robinhood Chain was the largest net outflow source of the day. The Arbitrum Orbit-based brokerage Layer 2, launched in July 2026, had recently ranked near the top in Meme and tokenized stock trading volume, and its on-chain fees briefly exceeded Ethereum, Solana, and Base, but daily bridged capital has now turned negative.

Arbitrum, Base, and Polygon also posted net outflows, bringing combined outflows across the four major Layer 2 networks, including Robinhood Chain, to about $69.55 million. Hyperliquid recorded $18.34 million in net outflows, nearly matching Arbitrum. New stablecoin settlement chains also saw capital leave, with Tether-backed Plasma outflowing $13.27 million, Stripe-incubated Tempo losing $3.45 million, and Tether ecosystem chain Stable seeing $2.99 million in outflows.

data.title: Ethereum Leads Cross-Chain Net Inflows With $46.47 Million Over 24 Hours
data.description:
DefiLlama data showed diverging cross-chain capital flows over the past 24 hours, with Ethereum recording about $46.47 million in net inflows, the highest among all chains. According to Odaily, the amount was about 4.5 times Solana's inflow.

Several L2 and emerging networks saw net outflows during the same period. Robinhood Chain led the outflows at about $21.07 million, while Arbitrum, Base, and Polygon also posted capital outflows. The four networks combined for about $69.55 million in net outflows.

data.title: Robinhood CEO Says Tokenization Is Opening U.S. Capital Markets to Global Investors
data.description:
Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said on X that tokenization is making high-quality financial assets in U.S. capital markets available to global investors. According to Odaily, he said the tokenization industry remains small compared with global financial markets, but its advantages in 24/7 trading, asset programmability, composability, and self-custody are becoming more apparent.

Tenev said traditional financial infrastructure is built on fixed trading hours, closed networks, and multiple layers of intermediaries, and no longer meets current investor demand. He added that founders, liquidity providers, traders, and infrastructure teams are all pushing the tokenization sector forward, but that it will take time for the traditional financial system to further accept the model.

data.title: Stargate V1 Pools to Shut Down as LayerZero Labs V1 Relayer Ends on December 15
data.description:
Stargate said its V1 liquidity pools will stop operating when the LayerZero Labs V1 relayer is discontinued on December 15. According to PANews, the shutdown will not affect Stargate V2 or Stargate Hydra.

To simplify the user experience, zero-fee withdrawals will be enabled for all users. Stargate said its V1 messaging service will be temporarily paused for about two weeks, after which V1 pool withdrawals will resume and remain open until the relayer is shut down on December 15. Users holding LP positions in Stargate V1 were told to remove those positions before that date.

data.title: STOCKS | Hyundai Steel Breaks Ground on $5.8 Billion Louisiana Steel Plant
data.description:
Hyundai Steel held a groundbreaking ceremony in Louisiana for an electric arc furnace steel plant with a total investment of $5.8 billion. According to Sina Finance, the company said on Friday that the project is scheduled to begin commercial production in 2029.

The plant will have an annual capacity of 2.7 million tons and will be operated by Hyundai-POSCO Louisiana Steel LLC, a joint venture formed by Hyundai Steel, POSCO, Hyundai Motor, and Kia. According to Sina Finance, the project is expected to create 5,400 jobs, including 1,300 direct positions.

The plant will supply automotive steel to Hyundai Motor's Alabama factory, Kia's production base in Georgia, and Hyundai Motor Group's U.S. mega factory in Georgia, as well as other U.S. automakers. According to Sina Finance, the steel plant is part of Hyundai Motor Group's $26 billion U.S. investment commitment through 2028.

The company said the integrated steel plant is the first of its kind in the United States, combining direct reduced iron production, electric arc furnace steelmaking, and downstream automotive steel rolling. According to Sina Finance, the process is expected to cut carbon emissions from crude steel production by about 70% compared with the company's traditional blast furnace process in South Korea.

data.title: USDC Supply Rises by About 600 Million in Week Ending September 3
data.description: Circle’s website shows that about 11 billion USDC were issued and about 10.4 billion were redeemed in the week ending September 3 local time, leaving circulating supply up by about 600 million. According to Foresight News, USDC circulation stood at about 74.3 billion as of September 3 local time, while reserve assets were valued at about $74.5 billion.

data.title: Anatoly Yakovenko Says Robinhood Revenue Share Covers Solana Trading Fees Four Times Over
data.description: Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko said Robinhood’s revenue share paid to Arbitrum is enough to cover roughly four times its trading fees on Solana. According to ChainCatcher, he said this would allow Robinhood to offer users a fully gas-free trading experience on Solana.

data.title: Solana Co-Founder Says Robinhood Chain Revenue Share Could Cover Four Times Solana's Transaction Fees
data.description:
Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko, known as Toly, said on X that Robinhood Chain's 10% revenue share paid to Arbitrum is enough to cover about four times Solana's transaction fees over the same period. According to Odaily, he added that if the revenue were used to subsidize user transactions, Robinhood Chain could offer a fully gas-free experience.

SolanaNews, citing Blockworks data, previously reported that Robinhood Chain's average transaction fee has recently risen to about $0.40 per transaction, more than 100 times Solana's fee and more than twice Ethereum's.

data.title: SLINK Surges to $80 Million Before Falling More Than 97%
data.description: SLINK briefly surged to a market value of about $80 million after Elon Musk replied to a post from Shivon Zilis' compromised account, according to Onchain Lens monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, multiple traders rushed into the token after the reply, and four traders alone lost about $807,000. SLINK later fell to about $2 million, dropping more than 97% from its peak.
